author: Joulx
body:
Sup, my name is Joulx, I have been playing PVP (competitive) Minecraft for about 3 years now, and I was thinking to join another team. I play many other games, mostly CS:GO (dat tec 9 life tho). I have Skype, Teamspeak, and Mumble. I will be usually free to play (FIGHT) most of the time and I'm willing to join any team that would like to have me in it. I have many features including PVP (duh), building for protection, and other useful strategies that would help the team to win. I will always try to help you (or anyone else) out so we can win for glory and bitchez (maybe...xD). So think about having me in your team, I would enjoy meeting you and your team! Until then, I'll catch you in the hood!
 
CLOSED! IN A TEAM NOW, DEXTERITY!
